question: Must annotation_set_ref_list.size equal the referenced prototype parameter count?
previous_assumption: Preflight Python oracle required equality and labelled the size1/prototype2 vector bad-parameter-arity.dex invalid.
new_evidence: Fixed SDK37 dexdump -f and hash-verified A0 Windows0.1.0 both returned exit0 for the same unchanged vector. Fixed ART verifier checks physical list/indices/owner but does not impose equality.
decision: Remove the unsupported equality assumption. Preserve exactly encoded slots and their ordinal; missing trailing prototype positions are not manufactured as NULL rows. Position-to-prototype binding is explicitly separate.
case_identity: bad-parameter-arity.dex retains its original filename and bytes for provenance, now classified valid_parameter_prefix_adjudicated.
unchanged_rejections: The size3 vector physically exceeds the ref-list section and is independently rejected by SDK and A0. Invalid owner/index/order/width/depth cases remain errors.
history: pre-adjudication/manifest.json and oracle-results.json retain the earlier preflight judgment. No production reader existed when the assumption was corrected.
scope: Format and compatibility boundary on controlled bytes only; no runtime reflection or complete Android installation claim.
